description: This Java source file defines a service class 'UndoLastDisbursalLoanCommandHandler' that handles commands to undo the last disbursal of a loan within the Apache Fineract project. It implements a command handler interface and uses dependency injection to access the loan write platform service, executing the undo operation transactionally.

classes.name: UndoLastDisbursalLoanCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles the undo of the last disbursal on a loan account, identified by a command.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to undo the last loan disbursal, executing within a transaction and delegating to the service layer.
